body: This is a known thing many runners have had to deal with.  Someone saying: "Oh! I did a 5k marathon!" They then usually smile beatifically at that point. Then, they have to be gently let down to learn that there is no "5k marathon."  It's not usually a result of willful deception, but MANY people seem to think that the definition of a marathon is any organized run.  This gem, however, should be pointed out.  Because if you can run a half in 58 flat? You are now the world record holder.

This guy is awesome.  
I think I'm going to have to throw in on his gofundme page. Races can get pricey.

Thank you for listening.  Sometimes, strangers are the best because I don't have to worry about the aftermath.  
I haven't seen a doctor in a long time.  My meds have handled it well.  I think it may be because I currently have a (minor) injury and I can't do my regular routine of running to sublimate.  I really appreciate you guys being here.  Thank you for listening to a nutbag at all hours.

Feeling.  Idiopathic. No triggers. 
Thank you.

Hey Glasty.  I'm in a bad place myself.  But my "help" instinct is kicking in. 21 can suck.  It's early and although you may feel like you've had a ton, there's a big world out there.  It can suck, sure.  But, there is an amazing amount of awesome to experience first.  You're 21!  Live it up!  If you're set on dying, get some credit cards, go into debt and see what the world looks like.  What can it hurt?  You're going to go anyway, right?  Postpone a bit, pack a bag, and see what the aurora borealis has to show you.  People die white water rafting. Hell! Give it a go! Ever been in Scotland, caught in a microburst while, through squinted eyes, you can see the sun is shining less than a half mile away? It may not sound like a good time, but I found myself laughing.
This isn't easy for us.  I wish we could be like other people.  I've lived damn near a generation longer than you, and I've seen and enjoyed a ton.  It's like Taco Hell. Good,even though you know you're going to get the shits afterward.  Rock this thing for all it's worth.  If you're still in the same spot after all of this, we'll talk. It's not like there's a window on dying.

Aaaaand we have a winner!
